raw_response:
This barley plot is small but it is mine, and barley is important for my family's food. I have some schooling and know that fertilizer helps the barley grow better, so I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative if I can get it in time, though I cannot afford the full recommended package. I will also spread manure from our animals since that costs nothing. For seed I will use what I saved from last season — improved barley seed is hard to find here and I trust the local variety. The plot is small enough that my family can manage most of the work ourselves, with only a little hired help at harvest.
